integrity: Published first-iterate extremizer classification attributed; algebraic optimization independently reconstructed; proof and standard-library verification included; no claim of external review.
scientific_limitations: The sharp value is only the supremum over constant-corrected lifts of known first-iterate extremizers; the unrestricted norm of the second iterate is not determined. The new strict global lower bound is certified by a constructed test function, not an upper bound. A 2026 forthcoming norm-estimates manuscript cited by the motivating source was not available for comparison. Numeric tests support but do not prove the analytic theorem.
title: Sharp constant correction of lifted Hardy \(H^4\) backward-shift extremizers
